title: PARDUS URAGANO F flat-bar gravel page recheck
notes: Exact URAGANO F manufacturer page titles it a flat-bar gravel road bike (平把砾石公路车) with gravel geometry, lists front and rear rack, fender, third-bottle and internal dropper provisions, a fork that accepts rack and fender mounts, long-distance travel and weekend camping uses, and a 700x45C or 650B x 2.1 in maximum. Fitted 38C tires are not the maximum.
